subject: MediWell - deployment path & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Kline <tkline@mediwell.com>; Procurement Team <procure@mediwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & what we need for a hosting recommendation

Tom — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your security and procurement teams have a single source of truth.

Recap (from our side):
- Primary workload: PHI-containing patient triage & visit summaries generated by the model.
- Expected steady-state: ~25 requests/min, typical prompt length 600 tokens, occasional peaks to ~120 requests/min during business hours.
- SLA expectations: 99.9% availability, 100ms median generation latency target for short prompts, tolerance to slightly higher latency on long sequences.
- Compliance drivers: HIPAA (BAA required), SOC 2 Type II evidence preferred, customer audit window 30–45 days after go-live.

Immediate asks from MediWell so we can finalize deployment recommendation:
1) Security questionnaire (you mentioned one you can share) — we can ingest and answer; please send the latest version.
2) Confirm whether you need a Dedicated capacity pool or an isolated Private VPC/on-prem deployment for PHI processing (you said security would decide).
3) Any hard constraints on data residency or key management (KMS/HSM) we should account for in the proposal.

Attachments requested from us: we will provide a BAA draft, a SOC 2 summary, and a short one-page ops runbook for the Dedicated vs Private options. Expect those in the next 24–48 hours.

Proposed next steps:
- Tom: share security questionnaire and any procurement timelines.
- Security team: indicate whether Private VPC is a hard requirement or if Dedicated (customer-dedicated GPU pool + BAA) is acceptable.
- We’ll route the appropriate evidence and a short tech writeup contrasting Hosted API + Dedicated + Private VPC for PHI.

Can we tentatively schedule a 30-min follow-up Wednesday to review the questionnaire answers? I’ll send a Calendly invite once we hear from security.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0138

From: Tom Kline <tkline@mediwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediWell Security <security@mediwell.com>, Procurement Team <procure@mediwell.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & what we need for a hosting recommendation

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. Attaching our security questionnaire here; apologies for the delay. We had a quick huddle and a few clarifications:

- Security leaning toward Private VPC because the model output will be stored in our EHR-linked data lake for 7 years and our compliance team wants tenant network isolation.
- Procurement would prefer to see a BAA draft and SOC2 Type II report before we lock in the procurement schedule (we have a June procurement window).
- KMS: we require customer-managed keys (BYOK) for production and a list of key rotation policies.

We'll expect the documents you mentioned. Tentatively our security lead suggested meeting next Friday (3/23) to go through the questionnaire answers and BAA redlines.

Tom
Tom Kline
Director, Platform Operations — MediWell Health
tkline@mediwell.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Kline <tkline@mediwell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & what we need for a hosting recommendation

Thanks, Tom / Marissa — I pulled together the quick mapping for the three deployment options and attached the BAA draft and SOC2 summary. High-level notes below so security has the tradeoffs at a glance: 

1) Hosted API (not recommended for PHI):
   - Pros: fastest onboarding, lower unit cost, transparent telemetry.
   - Cons: cannot meet MediWell's tenant isolation + BYOK requirement for production PHI.

2) Dedicated capacity (customer-dedicated GPU pool, Redwood-managed infra):
   - Pros: predictable throughput, single-tenant model instances, can offer BAA. Supports customer KMS integration for key wrapping in many clouds but may require a restricted network path for key exchange.
   - Cons: not full network-level isolation unless paired with Private VPC. 

3) Private VPC (customer VPC peering or on-prem package):
   - Pros: full network isolation, BYOK support, best fit for strict HIPAA setups and audit readiness. Can run our control plane in a customer-managed region for added governance.
   - Cons: longer lead time, higher TCO, more involved procurement and security review.

Actionable asks for MediWell to finalize our deployment recommendation: 
- Confirm whether Private VPC is mandatory for go-live or if Dedicated with KMS + BAA suffices for a pilot.
- Provide target go-live window and any audit dates (you mentioned an audit window 30–45 days post-go-live).
- Share expected QPS and retention policy for persisted outputs (if you plan to persist model outputs to the EHR-linked lake).

Attachments included (from Redwood): Redwood_BAA_Draft.pdf; SOC2-TypeII-Summary.pdf; short comparison doc (ops_runbook_dedicated_vs_private.pdf).

If Private VPC is required, we’ll schedule a technical prep call with infra and our deployment engineering team to capture network diagrams and KMS implementation details.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: Redwood_BAA_Draft.pdf (26KB), SOC2-TypeII-Summary.pdf (14KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Kline <tkline@mediwell.com>, MediWell Security <security@mediwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@mediwell.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 15:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & what we need for a hosting recommendation

Tom / Security team — thanks for sending the questionnaire. Per Karthik's note, we recommend the following immediate plan to keep your June procurement window intact while addressing audit needs:

1) Pilot (April-May): run a short pilot on Dedicated capacity with BAA + BYOK for keys. This lets MediWell validate throughput and integration with EHR flows while giving security the SOC2 summary and our BAA for redlines.

2) Parallel workstream: if security confirms Private VPC as non-negotiable, we’ll kick off the Private VPC readiness sprint (network diagrams, KMS handoff, on-prem checklist). That sprint typically adds 6–8 weeks.

3) Deliverables before your procurement review: Redwood_BAA_Draft.pdf (for redlines), SOC2-TypeII-Summary.pdf, ops_runbook_dedicated_vs_private.pdf, and answers to the attached questionnaire. I’ll circulate a short redline tracker for the BAA.

Proposed meeting: 30-min Q&A Friday 3/23 at 10:00am PT to review the questionnaire responses and BAA redlines. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a Loom walkthrough of the Dedicated vs Private differences for your security reviewers who want an async option.

Thanks — we’ll stand up the technical prep call as soon as security flags Private VPC as required.

Marissa
